Consequently the requested `IMPG_LOSS_DECOMP_LOCUS` comparison is **inapplicable** on an exact-2x2 chrVI window: that existing flag decomposes a single-allele loss only; instrumenting the pair against a missing second truth row would invent a comparison. Where BOTH are expressible (2/29), the objective can still favor a single; this check does not claim that the domain gap explains those two loci.

Sequence-nearest labels on 14 attested windows: 12 assign both copies to S288C, 2 both to SK1; neither recovers the two nonzero dosages. This is reference-windowed domain-frame debt, not a diploid-track execution failure: see `docs/syng-gmem-bwt/partition-native-spine.md`'s partition/territory-vs-window duality.

## Forced-diploid diagnostic — PRE-REGISTERED before execution
The owner-approved diagnostic constrains the *selected* chain to the existing two-real-slot DP track (`IMPG_FORCE_DIPLOID_DIAGNOSTIC=1`); haploid DP may still be computed as an observational comparison but **cannot be selected**. No objective, tables, pruning, dosage formula, or reference truth is changed. This flag is diagnostic-only; normal runs remain bit-identical. Before running chrI and chrVI, the predicted observations are: **(i)** chrI's 17 truth-pair-in-domain windows select the exact S288C+SK1 pair (whether-pair preference, not which-pair ranking, is the defect); **(ii)** chrVI's 27 SK1-inexpressible windows fill with confident *wrong* second slots if empty slots are denied; **(iii)** the dosage machinery remains uncalibrated to the true 1.2/0.8 because the feature-window mass is pooled. Decision test: selected route indices against exact truth-pair alleles at each in-domain locus; on inexpressible loci, report second-slot source/identity, confidence fields without promoting `null` masses to posterior probabilities; dosage from actual reported genotype columns and selected pair class counts. Preserve the 17-row pre-run delta unchanged. The production baseline for contrast is chrI 17/21 and chrVI 2/29 truth-pair-in-domain, both selected haploid; this is the pre-run record, not a post-hoc hypothesis.

### Forced-diploid diagnostic: chrI outcome (first run)
`IMPG_FORCE_DIPLOID_DIAGNOSTIC=1` is an env-gated **selection restriction**: the existing diploid DP has only two real slots; the haploid DP is still computed observationally, but its empty-slot route is never selected. chrI **exit 0 / 179s**, selected ploidy diploid, both slots real at all 21 windows. The 17 truth-pair-in-domain loci **match the exact truth pair 0/17** by source-named genotype allele IDs; the forced run's truth allele IDs are identical to the baseline's. Prediction (i) (true pair chosen when the whether-pair decision is taken away) is **REFUTED**. On 10 uniquely attested homolog windows, best 2x2 sequence accuracy **0.631852/10**; H1/H2 assignment flips each **1 over 7 adjacent attested boundaries**. The 11 correspondence brackets remain separate. Truth-pair self-test remains **1.0/0 over 10**. The genotype dosage columns **still say one class of 2 at all 21 windows**, rather than 1.2/0.8 — a locally called-pair output not recomputed from the forced selected chain. This diagnostic is NOT evidence that the which-pair ranking is sound: it instead produces many wrong real second slots even where the exact truth pair exists. chrVI still running serially.

### Speed directive correction (measured BEFORE draft surgery)

### (b) KNEE CUT DESIGN — APPROVAL REQUEST, NOT IMPLEMENTED
**Input mass must be defined before any cut.** Per-locus candidate states have existing finite m1 losses; normalize `log_mass_i = -(loss_i-min_loss) - logsumexp_j(-(loss_j-min_loss))` on the COMPLETE enumerable state set. Path-level bound must propagate excluded-state/pair mass through DP using proven per-boundary suffix bounds, not sum independent unnormalized local tails. Final argmin and objective must be compared against the uncut baseline at chrMT/p1; no new untuned mass bound may be asserted merely from rank. ### (c) PROPOSED BOUND DESIGN FOR OWNER APPROVAL — no unapproved knee implementation
Use a pre-charge **record-side per-feature observed upper bound** `O_f(owner)` already derivable from indexed routed/crossing record shares, and an exact lower envelope of the existing loss for ALL nonnegative predicted exposure `s`: `min_{s>=0}[s - O_f log(1+s/beta_f)] = 0` if `O_f<=beta_f`, else `O_f-beta_f-O_f log(O_f/beta_f)`. Sum this conservative envelope over a provable superset of possible seam features for a pair/owner to obtain an admissible seam-charge floor WITHOUT exact MEM profile/record crossing. For restricted charges, `O_f` must cover every record share that `JunctionSpanIndex::restricted_charge` can match (not just observed in the neighboring windows); otherwise the floor is invalid. Profile-feature prediction and the owner-specific observed superset may themselves cost too much; first instrument their bound tightness and construction time on boundaries 50/91/105 without cutting. If the analytic floor is too loose, do NOT ship the knee; escalate to a separately approved richer pre-charge index. This is a mathematical candidate, NOT an already proved or implemented certificate; the retained selected pair at boundary91 is the indispensable negative control.

## FINAL OWNER-CONFIRMED DIPLOID ASSESSMENT: INJECTIVE LOCAL GENOTYPE PAIRS ON ATTESTED HOMOLOG WINDOWS
**Third supersession; this section replaces BOTH 0.5169026601 (a single call block-wise credited against both truths) and 0.5241800568 (whole-chromosome slot↔truth assignment).** Both evaluated at the wrong unit: the inference outputs a separate **unordered local genotype pair** at each locus, not a physically assembled global two-molecule FASTA. New assessment-only source `genome/instrumented/score-diploid-genotype.py`, serial saved-route runner `run-diploid-genotype.sh`, and source-named tests compute the owner's primitive:

For each locus with a **full-length, primary, unique, positive-mapq alignment** of the S288C axis window onto SK1 (the SAME preexisting mappy orthology/correspondence gate as `score-diploid.py`), let `T1` be the S288C local allele and `T2` the oriented SK1 local homolog's **full attested span**. Spell the saved two per-locus called rows as `C1,C2`; for this fleet `C2=EMPTY` everywhere. Local edit costs use edlib **global NW distance** on the full local allele strings; `d(EMPTY,T)=len(T)`. The locus's **injective** two-copy error is `min[d(C1,T1)+d(C2,T2), d(C1,T2)+d(C2,T1)]`. Do not greedily match both calls to one truth. Sum errors and the two local truth allele lengths over ALL **attested** loci for a genome-weighted distance. The non-attested SK1 windows have NO local ortholog sequence authorized by this correspondence rule: no fabricated zero-length `T2`, no score/no implied accuracy; count them as separate brackets with their S288C axis bp, retaining locus IDs and null assignment. Truth self and swapped-self local matches are zero, including inversion-oriented SK1 alleles.

**DIPLOID VERDICT ON THE ASSESSABLE 753/1,307 LOCI: `7,693,342 / 15,001,948 = 0.5128228680701999` per-locus two-truth genotype distance.** Of the **7,693,342** errors, **7,489,051** are the full lengths of attested local truth alleles assigned to the EMPTY inferred second slot; the occupied call contributes **204,291** edlib disagreement bp. The other **554/1,307** loci (S288C axis **4,751,852** bp) are **BRACKETED: this yardstick CANNOT assess their SK1 allele**. The 15,001,948-bp denominator is the **SUM OF BOTH LOCAL TRUTH ALLELE LENGTHS AT ATTESTED LOCI**, not the former whole-physical-truth 24,390,865-bp denominator. The result MUST NOT be presented as a complete 1,307-locus two-copy genome distance or as one molecule covering two homologs. Original production's all-single-slot result remains a DIPLOID PRODUCT FAILURE: one real row plus an empty row at each of 1,307 windows, one dosage class of 2 versus truth S288C 1.2/SK1 0.8.

**Exactly what was compared, without smuggling a product change:** source `examples/panel_route_spine/cosine_probe.rs` is env-gated by `IMPG_COSINE_DIAG_OUTPUT` and writes separate JSONL after the unchanged diploid DP; no sweep/DP/posterior/reference output reads its result. The existing routing pass supplies each record's physical MEM-subwalk placements and established equal share `multiplicity/touched_partition_count`. ARM A unions a record's overlapping placement spans on each panel path, contributing the equal share **once per covered base per record**, not once per overlapping subwalk; it intersects with the union of the candidate alleles' actual source intervals and emits disjoint `(path,lo,hi,coverage)` bins, including zero-coverage material. A candidate diplotype expects +15 per occupied copy at each covered physical base, and cosine dot/norm are bp-width weighted. ARM B uses the SAME physical allele pairs' MEM-subwalk oracle profiles multiplied by depth15, the observed `window_obs` FeatureKey shares, and includes predicted-only keys in the expected norm. Neither arm imports the old omission-charge likelihood, its multiplicity backgrounds or its post-hoc reference truth into the observed vector. Truth is assessment-side only. Orientations that spell the same physical source material can tie; this diagnostic is not an ancestry/phasing test. An observed record placing on multiple panel paths may contribute its routed equal share at each path, matching the routing share convention; it is not a uniquely mapped read.

**Restriction/equivalence disclosure:** for each expressible locus the comparison includes the exact truth pair, actual selected ordered pair, the eight best *unrestricted* finite class pairs by the old objective (even if port-nonviable), and the eight best *port-viable* finite class pairs; each class is represented by its first member or first viable member, with duplicate physical allele-index pairs collapsed. There are **9–18 distinct tested physical pairs/locus**; the many non-materialized other diplotypes were NOT ranked. Thus `447/498` is **restricted-comparison rank1**, not proof of a full-domain cosine argmax, not a 447/498 exact genotype call, and not license to delete read-accounting or reference columns. Arm-A full 498-wrong rank histogram: ranks `1:447, 2:30, 3:9, 4:7, 5:3, 7:1, 8:1`; arm B `1:422, 2:39, 3:22, 4:4, 5:1, 6:2, 7:5, 9:2, 10:1`. Of all 502, arm A rank1 incl ties **451** (unique **378**), B **426** (unique **351**). Restriction means any future all-pair production objective needs an exhaustive or certified candidate-universe gate before claiming accuracy.

**What the experiment supports and does NOT support:** the actual implementation compared predicted MEM subwalk/window-mass profiles to routed mass using background-relative Poisson and a dominant in-window omission charge. `docs/syng-gmem-bwt/partition-local-diplotype-inference.md` deliberately borrowed COSIGT's *pair enumeration* but explicitly substituted Poisson for cosine; labeling that older likelihood "COSIGT-pattern local scoring" was incorrect. The owner's coverage-vector comparison is a measured *better ranking on this restricted diagnostic*: A gives **25 more rank1 rescues** than B on 498 wrong-selected loci, though B itself recovers **422/498**. Consequently **the likelihood/comparison form is directly implicated**, but the claim that the *pooled observed vector alone* causes all failure is NOT supported: cosine even in that feature space often ranks truth at/near top. Likewise, A still fails rank1 at **51/498** sampled comparisons and ties at many loci; the proven external COSIGT result cannot simply be transferred as complete-genome success here.

Every admissible unordered vector pair is scored by `(<x,e_i>+<x,e_j>)/sqrt(||x||²(||e_i||²+||e_j||²+2<e_i,e_j>))`, with bp-overlap row dot/norm precomputed and every record's overlapping placement spans unioned once before m/t share addition. No Poisson/omission scores, reference truth, oracle-projected copy, or source-family prior enters the observed vector or pair score; attested truth enters only rank assessment. The pilot reported only Stage-1 local comparisons, not whole-molecule DP outcomes. ## 2026-10-01 SESSION OPEN — GRAPH-SPACE CONDENSATION + NODES/EDGES FULL-DOMAIN GATE (chrMT/chrI)

Owner go-ahead: build the graph-space evidence condensation (observed = routed share mass on graph segments PLUS edge-layer adjacency usage from span-index crossing records; expected = candidate diplotype's two paths' node+edge usage at depth 15; factorized cosine over combined node+edge space), then EXHAUSTIVE full-domain ranking on chrMT and chrI over ALL candidates, naming near-twin competitors and truth's whole-domain rank, with nodes-only vs nodes+edges as separate measured numbers. Stage scope is the FIRST CHECKPOINT ONLY: this build + gate, committed with measured numbers. No 502-locus proof, no selection swap, no PR push. Writing begins; incremental updates follow.

**Increment 1 — graph-space build design (before implementation).** The panel graph used is the loaded syng GBWT itself (`SyngIndex`): its nodes are the signed syncmer k-mer segments (1-based ids, sign = strand; ~10.0M vertices for the 235-strain panel), shared across paths wherever sequence is conserved — `panel.walk_path_range(path, lo, hi)` spells (node, bp) steps along any panel path, and node identity is frame-independent (the territory code documents this). This supplies the previously missing shared-node coordinate map without inventing an alignment: conserved placements collapse to shared node ids by the panel's own interning; diverged k-mers are distinct nodes. Observed (node layer): per locus, each contributing routed record's equal share `m/t` votes once per graph node whose k-mer window is fully contained in the union of the record's routed placement spans (all features, both frames, merged per path; per-record per-node dedup across paths — the read votes a shared node once however many conserved paths it places on; the `physical_material_row` routing convention stays). Observed (edge layer): the adjacencies the placed records span — consecutive covered steps along the placement path form edge votes `(abs(node_t), abs(node_{t+1}))` ordered by bp, same per-record once-per-edge dedup and share mass; a junction adjacency that no single record spans would need the span index's chain-pair crossing machinery, but the pure-route domain cannot contain such junctions (admissible rows are `single:` or strictly adjacent same-source `stitch:`, so every spelled adjacency is same-path continuous and abundantly spanned by single records) — the measured multi-segment/stitch row counts are reported per locus so the edge layer's chain channel is an audited zero, not an assumption. Expected: each candidate row's node/edge usage = its merged per-path intervals' fully-contained steps and their consecutive pairs, depth 15 per covered copy with repeat-visit multiplicity preserved. Cosine factorization carries over per row: `d_i` (node dot + edge dot), `n_i` (node norm + edge norm), `g_ij` (node overlap + edge overlap) — two separate score arms over the same coalesced row universe (coalesced on EXACT node-multiset + edge-multiset equality): (A) nodes-only, (B) nodes+edges. The edge layer's contribution is reported as separate measured numbers (per-locus rank deltas between arms, edge masses, competitor counts). Truth assessment-side only via the existing exact-segment truth index; 1e-12 tie convention; fail-closed zero norms; exhaustive ALL-pairs enumeration per locus over the entire domain; no thresholds, no constants. Gate env: `IMPG_COSINE_GRAPH_OUTPUT` (requires `IMPG_COSINE_DOMAIN_PILOT`), dump beside the row-space pilot in `cosine_probe.rs`, receipts `run-cosine-graph-pilot-{chrMT,chrI}.*`, serial, stdbuf, 64GiB guard, sweep-only, pilot cwd redirect. Scope: chrMT + chrI first checkpoint only; no 502 run, no selection/viability change, no PR push.

**Increment 2 — implementation state.** `examples/panel_route_spine/cosine_probe.rs` now carries `dump_graph_exhaustive` (env `IMPG_COSINE_GRAPH_OUTPUT`, requires the pure-route `IMPG_COSINE_DOMAIN_PILOT` gate, hooked in `mod.rs` beside the row-space pilot with `rss_probe`): per locus it gathers every candidate row's merged per-path material and every contributing routed record's merged placement spans (all features, both frames), does ONE bounding-range `panel.walk_path_range` walk per path, extracts window-contained syncmer nodes and their consecutive-step adjacency edges per interval, builds the candidate-usage universe, accumulates per-record once-per-node/edge share votes, coalesces rows on exact (node-multiset, edge-multiset) equality, and scores ALL unordered graph-row pairs in both arms (nodes-only; nodes+edges) with the factored arithmetic (`d_i`/`n_i`/`g_ij`, 1e-12 tie convention, fail-closed zero norms). Census streams per-locus domains, identity kinds, the path-continuity audit (`multi_segment_rows`, `disjoint_material_rows`), universes, masses, eligible pairs per arm, truth presence/rank/ties per arm, best per arm, competitor-entry counts; the competitors file names every pair above truth in either arm with identities, node/edge counts and both arm scores. Rust tests: 9/9 `cosine_` pass (incl. new graph factorization-vs-direct-dense pair score with repeat-visit multiplicity and a same-row double-copy pair, window containment, multiset overlap, packed-edge ordering, exact-equality coalescing, row bp continuity). chrMT pilot launched (serial, sweep-only, pilot cwd redirect, stdbuf, RSS poller + 64GiB guard).

**Increment 3 — chrMT first checkpoint measured (serial run, exit 0, wall 49s, peak external RSS 13,805,280 kB, internal guard clean).** Graph-space condensation over the FULL chrMT domain (2,711 physical rows, all `single:`, `multi_segment_rows=0` and `disjoint_material_rows=0` at every locus — the chain-junction channel is a MEASURED empty set, not an assumption) coalesces to 59-157 graph rows per locus (near-twin collapse). ## 2026-10-01 QUAL EMISSION STAGE COMPLETE — MATERIAL-CLASS CALLED SETS + PHRED QUAL, EXHAUSTIVE chrMT/chrI

**Supervisor decision received mid-stage (the ruling's formula and its worked example were mathematically inconsistent at tied called sets; escalated, not silently decided):** the owner's refined product semantics are MATERIAL-CLASS level — candidates that are the same effective material are not alternatives ("low quality is not bad here because maybe the other alternatives are the SAME effectively"), and member multiplicity must not inflate confidence. Concretely: (1) candidates with bit-identical node+edge usage signatures coalesce into one material class — already true in the stage-1 condensation at ROW level, so a candidate class is an unordered pair of coalesced graph rows and the class weight is the class's OWN similarity value, never the member-summed one; (2) share = s_win / (sum of s_c over DISTINCT material classes); (3) QUAL = -10*log10(1 - share) per locus, and a k-way tie means k DISTINCT classes at the max, with the bound Q = -10*log10(1-1/k) for an all-mass k-class tie (the B reading, at class level); (4) the called set is the distinct classes at the bit-identical maximum, emitted as class signatures, not member route identities. Exact-tie convention stated: identical f64 score values; every score is finite, non-NaN, non-negative and -0.0 cannot arise (non-negative dots over positive norms), so IEEE-754 equality IS bit identity; NO epsilon constant enters the product call. The owner's example formula is a THEOREM at class level: for a k-way tie at s, the k classes alone contribute k*s to the denominator, so share <= 1/k and Q <= -10*log10(1-1/k), equality iff the tie holds all the domain's similarity mass.

**Implementation:** `examples/panel_route_spine/cosine_probe.rs::dump_graph_exhaustive` now accumulates, per locus on the nodes+edges arm (the stage-1 machinery), the total similarity over every distinct class (deterministic enumeration order), collects the called set at the bit-identical maximum, and emits per locus: `qual_similarity_total`, `qual_best_similarity`, `qual_called_class_count`, `qual_called_classes` (row indices, per-row member counts, physical-pair multiplicity, node/edge counts, usage signature hashes, usage distance and DIFFERING OBSERVED MASS versus the first called class, is_truth_class), `qual_called_physical_pairs`, `qual_truth_in_called_set`, `qual_share`, `qual_unbounded`, `qual` (null when unbounded or massless — never clamped), plus a new `.ties.jsonl` stream: every class within the stage-1 1e-12 window of the truth class (truth class included) with ULP delta, bit-exactness flag, node/edge usage distance AND differing observed mass versus the truth class, shared-row count, member counts. `genome/instrumented/check-cosine-graph-receipt.py` extended: re-derives share (exact IEEE division), Phred QUAL, physical-pair multiplicities, truth-in-called-set (twice: by class membership and by bit-equality of the truth score with the max — equivalent because the called set is every class at the bit-identical max), asserts the k-way bound fail-closed, reconciles the ties stream against the stage-1 tied counter, and verifies the re-run reproduces every stage-1 integer/mask/rank field exactly with a DOCUMENTED cross-run tolerance on the six HashMap-ordered float fields (the observed-norm sums and the cosines derived from them vary a few f64 ULPs across processes — measured max 4e-16 relative, changing no rank, tie or count; the tolerance is receipt reconciliation, not a product constant). (2) Monotonicity: QUAL is a strictly monotone function of the share by construction (unit-proven) and measured monotone across all 35 loci; spot-check: chrMT tied locus7 share 1.37e-4 -> Q 0.00060 vs separated unique-top locus5 share 4.02e-3 -> Q 0.01751. (3) **The honest caveat: "unique separations give high Q" is FALSE in these measured domains** — a unique, well-separated top still holds only ~1e-4 of the domain's similarity mass because thousands of eligible near-twin classes each carry substantial cosine, so every realistic QUAL is near zero; high QUAL under this forced normalization requires the called class to dominate the domain's TOTAL similarity, which coalesced near-twin-rich domains never allow (only the 4 degenerate single-class domains are unbounded). QUAL does not track the best-vs-truth or best-vs-second delta across loci; it tracks the share. **THE SCIENTIFIC CRUX, ANSWERED WITH NUMBERS (the stage's headline finding):** the near-twin runner-ups at these 25 truth-expressible loci are **DIVERGENT MATERIALS SCORING (NEARLY) EQUALLY — the hard problem — NOT near-identical bands.** Every non-degenerate locus's spectrum HAS a knee (12/12 chrMT, 19/19 chrI; NO no-knee spectrum occurs), but the knee-cut cluster is almost everywhere TINY — 2–15 classes out of 1,127–23,871 (only chrMT locus5: 253/275, chrI locus3: 61, chrI locus8: 1256 form substantial bands) — and the class supplying `a` differs from the winner on material carrying **0.7%–90% of the locus's total observed read mass (median ≈ 20%)** while scoring **78.8–99.99% of the maximum similarity**. The measured "twins" are not the owner's almost-identical sequences: their differing material carries REAL read evidence (e.g. chrI locus2's row-space-exposed `5397:[23841,29584)` differs on 2.2% of the observed mass and scores 99.93% of max; chrMT locus2's top rival differs on 35.9% and scores 99.91%), so the read sample CAN in principle distinguish them and simply scores them nearly equally. The owner's benign case is realized only in fragments: chrI locus8 (the knee absorbs a 1256-class conserved band, a falls 0.5903→0.4717, Q re-rates 3.04→3.56), chrMT locus5 (253 classes, 3.03→3.15) — and even there the best genuinely divergent rival still scores 78.8%/93.9% of max, so Q never exceeds 3.56.

**Re-rated QUAL distribution vs the delta-form band:** delta 31 finite, Q 1.76–3.23, median ~3.015, 4 unbounded (the k=2 ties at 1.76); cluster 31 finite, Q 3.01–3.56, median ~3.03, same 4 unbounded; re-rated loci 6/14 (chrMT) + 11/21 (chrI). The two measured k=2 bit-ties re-rate exactly as the ruling requires — chrMT locus7: 1.76→3.06, chrI locus14: 1.76→3.03 — because their tie partners sit at material distance 0.0 (the measured zero-differering-observed-mass tie anatomy), land INSIDE the called cluster, and no longer halve p: they are effectively the same material, per the ruling "they shouldn't get penalized as if they're not [real alternatives]". k = 1 at EVERY measured locus (0/35 loci with ≥2 divergent tied clusters); a genuinely divergent bit-tie keeps the k=2 bound by the unit test. **Measured reduction checks:** (i) high Q occurs NOWHERE outside the degenerate unbounded domains — not a formula artifact but the honest measurement that no exhaustive domain contains a far tail (min a/s_win 0.788, chrI locus8); the owner's ten-sequences case rates high in the unit-proven synthetic form (`cluster_form_qual_owner_reductions`: nine distance-0.001 twins + far tail → p 0.909) but is not instantiated by these domains; (ii) the measured bit-ties are near-identical (distance 0) and re-rate as unique maxima — the divergent bit-tie reduction is unit-proven at the k=2 bound; (iii) ALL 31 finite loci keep a divergent near-score rival outside the cluster supplying a → Q stays 3.01–3.56; (iv) every zero-distance class is inside the cluster, never supplies a, never counts in k (checker-asserted). **Monotonicity measured at cluster level:** p falls as a/s_win rises across all k=1 loci (checker-asserted over the full sorted ratio sequence), and the counterfactual absorbing the best divergent rival into the band strictly raises p at every locus with a second-best outside similarity (checker-asserted). **Truth-in-called-set UNCHANGED (2/8 chrMT: loci 2, 5; 1/17 chrI: locus 6)** — the formula change moves QUALITY, not the CALL. The second view agrees everywhere: every locus also shows a knee in signature-cosine space with thin cuts (0.002–0.52), so the near-bands are thin in raw usage space too.

**Increment 1 — GATE 1 PASSED (commit 087a89f).** The model derived and implemented (the derivation documented in docs/syng-gmem-bwt/cosine-coverage-objective.md, "Per-record likelihood comparison"): counts C_g = the record-once routed-share masses per universe key (the same observed side the cosines aggregate — the per-record granularity is the records' share addends); rates lambda_c(g) = M*E_c(g)/Q_c on the class's keys, E = the class's summed read-covering incidence per spelled instance (the structured-poisson exposure conversion, per-key: nodes L-k+1=88 clipped to the path, edges 88-gap), M = the locus's realized share-mass budget — the empirical-Bayes calibration FORCED BY MEASUREMENT (the depth-anchored form predicts ~8.8 units/single-copy key uniformly; the realized universe densities span 0.05-4.0 across these loci, so raw depth rates over-predict everywhere and collapse the ranking toward minimal material); keys outside the class spelled at the max-entropy uniform background beta = M/|U| (the B1/B2 omission structure). NLL per class = the per-key Poisson deviance over the whole universe; the lnGamma count-costs cancel (candidate-independent) and are carried in the emitted logL. The closed form NLL = CONST + M_c*ln(Q_c*beta/M) - A_c - K_c*beta computes per pair in ONE O(keys) merge per arm (Q additive over rows) — the same incremental shape as the cosine walk. The EXACT per-record identity (rate budgets thinned over R records, per-record share-mass terms at the class's rate vs the background, count-costs split by share) is emitted for the named classes and unit-proven to reconstitute the class NLL. Fail-closed: massless locus -> null for all; observed mass on a zero-incidence key or zero total incidence -> class ineligible. QUAL: the already-built cluster machinery with RELATIVE likelihoods exp(logL-logL_win) as the spectrum scores — knee/k/a semantics EXACTLY unchanged, p = L_win/(k*L_win + L_a) (the forced two-way = the flat-prior posterior of the top cluster vs the best divergent rival), plus the full-domain posterior emitted as the natural measurement. ## 2026-10-02 PER-RECORD LIKELIHOOD COMPARISON STAGE COMPLETE — THE OWNER'S GO-AHEAD MEASURED ON EXHAUSTIVE chrMT/chrI (COMMITTED 087a89f + 7d4726f + 0ace7e3)

**The model exactly as derived (documented in docs/syng-gmem-bwt/cosine-coverage-objective.md, "Per-record likelihood comparison").** The condensed node+edge coordinates STAY; the comparison is now the COSIGT-style per-record Poisson likelihood at read granularity: every universe key g carries the observed count C_g = the sum of routed shares m_r of the records covering it (the per-record granularity IS the records' share addends); a diplotype class c predicts lambda_c(g) = M*E_c(g)/Q_c on its keys (E = the class's summed read-covering incidence per spelled instance — the structured-poisson exposure conversion, per-key: nodes 88 = L-k+1 clipped to the path, edges 88-gap) with M = the locus's realized share-mass budget (the empirical-Bayes calibration FORCED BY MEASUREMENT: the depth-anchored rate predicts ~8.8 units/single-copy key uniformly while the realized universe densities span 0.05-4.0 across these loci — raw depth rates over-predict everywhere and collapse the ranking); keys outside the class explained at the max-entropy uniform background beta = M/|U| (the B1/B2 omission structure). NLL_c = the per-key Poisson deviance over the whole universe; the lnGamma count-costs cancel (candidate-independent) and ride in the emitted logL. The closed form (NLL = CONST + M_c*ln(Q_c*beta/M) - A_c - K_c*beta) computes per pair in ONE O(keys) merge per arm — the same incremental shape as the cosine walk. The EXACT per-record identity (rate budgets thinned over the R records; each record's share mass at the class's rate where consistent, at the background where not; count-costs split by share) is emitted per named class and unit-proven to reconstitute the class NLL. FAIL-CLOSED: massless locus -> null for all; observed mass on a zero-incidence key or zero total incidence -> class ineligible. QUAL: the ALREADY-BUILT cluster machinery with RELATIVE likelihoods exp(logL-logL_win) as the spectrum scores — knee/k/a semantics EXACTLY unchanged, p = L_win/(k*L_win + L_a) (the forced two-way = the flat-prior posterior of the top cluster vs the best divergent rival, uniform-within-tied-set); the full-domain flat-prior posterior emitted beside it. NO free parameters; exact IEEE ranking (no epsilon — the 1e-12 window was a cosine-scale convention that does not transfer).

**Mid-stage bug found by the checker's independent re-derivation (commit 7d4726f):** the closed form charged the explained-rate budget M unconditionally; an incidence-free class (an empty-usage row pair — real domain members: candidate intervals too short for any syncmer window) predicts mass NOWHERE (sum-lambda = 0, not M). Fixed, unit-proven against the dense form, both arms re-run before any receipt was kept. The same commit fixed the rival-naming flood (relative scores underflow to 0.0 below ~745 log units and named thousands of classes as "the" rival; the naming now uses absolute log-likelihood equality) and added the measured log-gap field `qual_alternative_log_gap` so unbounded QUAL emissions keep their honest measurement.

## 2026-11-06 SESSION OPEN — THE LOCAL-REALIGNMENT EVIDENCE MODEL (owner direction: reads currently reach the panel through exact syncmer matches only — variant bases never testify, and mass folds very far because identical sequence interns to one node; the fix is per-read FULL-SEQUENCE local alignment likelihood against each candidate haplotype path in the partition graph). THE DESIGN, as ruled: (1) per-read likelihood under candidate path P = P(read | generated from P) from the read's local alignment to P's spelled sequence — match/mismatch scoring from the reads' own base qualities if the sample carries them, else a stated uniform scoring derived from the measured error profile; (2) THE FACTORIZED EXACT FORM: align once to the placed backbone; likelihood under P = backbone term + sum over P's variant pockets of the read's base evidence covering those pockets — VALIDATE the factorization against a brute-force full alignment EXACTLY on a measured sample of reads x paths, unit-proven; (3) NO SHARE-SPLITTING for per-read path likelihood — each path is an independent hypothesis, reads multi-matching several local paths get independent likelihoods under each; (4) candidate scoring = sum of per-read log-likelihoods over the locus's records (record-once budget discipline carries over); QUAL = the existing cluster machinery over the likelihood ratios, unchanged. GATES in order: (1) factorized build with the exactness proof vs brute-force; (2) SMEAR-CLASS CHECK: measured variant-pocket evidence mass now visible that seed projection dropped; (3) exhaustive chrMT/chrI full-domain rankings under the realignment likelihood — truth rank, log-gap, QUAL per locus, before/after vs the current instrument; (4) THE PREDICTION TABLE: chrI L7/L8/L13/L15/L16/L18 + chrMT L2/L6/L10 close where variants discriminate; chrMT L3/L5 + chrI L4/5/6/L12 hold; identical-through-graph pairs (5397/5545) stay tied — CORRECTLY; near-twins resolve where variant pockets exist; (5) walls, domain sizes, the 64GiB guard. **Increment 1 (realign session) — SURVEY COMPLETE; THE MODEL DERIVED AND SETTLED against the artifacts.** (1) THE READS: `$D/reads.fastq.gz`, 2,439,103 reads, L150, ALL quality bytes uniform 'I' = Phred 40 — the sample carries base qualities, so the scoring uses them: per-base error probability ε = 10^(−40/10) = 1e-4; match probability 1−ε, mismatch probability ε/3 (the uniform substitution model derived from the reads' own quality strings; the measured error profile is stated beside it: the multi-census measured zero unmatched placement bp over 1,063,522 occurrences — reads are exact panel segments where placed). (2) THE GENERATIVE MODEL (substitution-only, single-offset, ALL placements): P(read | generated from row R) = Σ over BOTH read strands, Σ over EVERY offset σ with the read fully inside R, of (1/(2·len_R))·Π_i P(read_i | R[σ+i]) — the FULL-SEQUENCE local alignment likelihood: every base of the read votes at every placement; no seed restriction anywhere (the seed model's dropped evidence = the sub-syncmer and pocket-interior positions, all restored); indels between read and row are not representable under substitution-only generation and score as the shifted mismatches they are (the row carrying the read's own indel structure is the one that can generate the read — stated rule, no gap constants). Score per placement = m·A + c·B with integers m (matches) and c = 150−m (mismatches + out-of-extent unexplained bases), A = ln(1−ε), B = ln(ε/3) — ONE canonical closed form; per-row likelihood = canonical logsumexp over the offset histogram minus ln(len_R) (the uniform placement prior, both strands at 1/2). (3) THE FACTORIZED EXACT FORM (the owner's (2)): the locus frame = the axis row (the S288C#0 member row — the instrument's own coordinate convention); per row R its VARIANT POCKETS vs the frame precomputed once (collinear shared-node runs; SNV edits inside untorn runs; indel runs = torn regions, named); per record its frame projection + its own alt bases (from its occurrence path segment, cached once = "align the read once to its placed backbone"); per (record,R) the frame-collinear placement's (m,c) computed PURELY from the two cached pocket lists (backbone term + the read's base evidence over R's pockets) — asserted EQUAL to the direct full-sequence walk (INTEGER equality) over the WHOLE exhaustive domain, not a sample; torn/edge/non-frame placements named and computed by the bounded direct walk (the named brute-force-per-candidate component). (4) NO SHARE-SPLITTING: per-read per-row likelihoods are independent; the record contributes ONCE × its multiplicity; multi-matching reads get independent likelihoods under every row (max/logsumexp within a row is over that row's own placements, not a split). **THE ANATOMY'S HEADLINE DISCOVERY (escalated to the owner mid-slice, non-blocking): the pocket reads are NOT remote/foreign-generated.** EVERY one of the 1,603 winner-only-placed units (mass 1,677) has a FULL-READ 150/150 match on the sample's own donor paths S288C#0#chrI / SK1#0#chrI (the anatomy's donor-check, origin-shift-corrected, strand-aware, per unit): **1,051 units (66%) match INSIDE window 7's own truth rows** (the truth folds' rows spell them exactly), 426 (27%) in the neighboring ±2kb seam, only 126 far. Yet the truth folds place NONE of the in-window ones: **2,059 units (mass 2,140) at L7 have an in-window full-match donor occurrence with NO valid truth placement.** THE CAUSE, proven with a named example (record 113 / unit 84 / node 92071, cross-checked against the fold's committed walk): the fold PIN SKELETONS are built from `walk_path_range` — ONE frame's syncmer selection — and reads whose anchor k-mers are **rc-frame-qualified on the truth path are ABSENT from that walk** (slice A's binding lesson, recorded as a warning for slice B, missed in the pin skeleton; the stored-frame walk carries OTHER syncmer windows at those positions — nodes 7446960/9705993/7362615 at the anchor's window) while the same k-mers appear canonical-forward on the reverse-complement scaffold copies, which pin and collect the full match at orientation 1. **The truth's 150*B floor for these reads is a PLACEMENT-MACHINERY FRAME ARTIFACT, not an inability to spell them.** The slice-B "54,015 per-base logs" also decompose into one-homolog floor asymmetries (±1,546-magnitude mixture terms — 973 mass winner-places/truth-floors vs 828 mass the reverse), not per-base evidence: on jointly-placed reads the truth's per-base evidence is BETTER (m 146.8 / c 1.08 vs the winner's 142.9 / 2.93). **GATE 2-3 — THE MARGINALIZATION (the owner's design, verbatim; implemented in examples/partition_realign_score.rs, assessment-side, no src/ file touched, no thresholds, no tuning constants):** LL(read | candidate) = logsumexp( the local-spell branch (the existing per-(record,row) likelihood: the uniform placement prior + the anchored placements' backbone + skipped-base votes) , E(read) ). **THE E-DERIVATION, documented** (the example header, the docs note, the receipt's scoring block, checker-audited): E(read) = len(read)·A − ln(2·(G_diploid − len(read) + 1)) — the read explained by the genome outside this locale at the MEASURED per-base rate (the census's zero-unmatched-bp measurement over 1,063,522 verified occurrences: reads are exact segments of their origins, at the reads' own Phred-40-derived rate A) under the max-entropy uniform origin over the donor's diploid genome — **the same max-entropy spirit as the old Poisson model's beta = M/|U|**: the unit of match likelihood spread uniformly over the universe of placements; G measured TRUTH-FREE from the panel (the instrument's own genome universe): the mean per-(strain,haplotype) total path length **14,199,901.5 bp over 235 haplotype path sets, doubled for the diploid = 28,399,803 bp; E = −17.870035**. THE FLOOR for unexplained reads is E, not 150*B (which survives only as the per-placement lower bound inside the local branch's logsumexp — a bit-exact no-op where anchors pin). A read whose local placements score no better than E does not vote beyond E; **logsumexp2 is monotone in the local branch — the L4-control preservation property, unit-proven** (a candidate at least as good as every rival per unit keeps its ordering; identical folds stay identical). The control experiment isolated TWO stacked effects: (1) the committed "serial" runs were never single-threaded in the loci loop — the per-locus scoring/classes/spectrum par_iters ride rayon's DEFAULT pool (the whole box), and bounding the pool to the rung width silently serialized THOSE phases too (serial code at RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2: loci 8.2s, still 4.5x over the 1.8s default-pool wall); (2) nesting the seam par_iter in the SAME bounded pool adds contention on top (18.5s: two concurrent loci each enqueueing thousands of inner jobs onto the same 2 workers). NO RACE: even that pathological run's receipts were byte-identical, all four sidecars, 0 semantic diffs. THE CORRECTED MECHANISM (seam_map, in-code documented): the seams run on DEDICATED scoped std::threads at width N (stride-assigned, per-item result slots read out in item order — interleaving-independent by construction), and from a non-rayon thread every inner par_iter installs rayon's GLOBAL pool — the committed inner behavior, unchanged. THE 2-WIDE PILOT (the corrected mechanism, both components, exit 0, 64GiB guard clean): chrMT wall 14s (serial re-baseline 18s) poller peak 2,329,120kB; chrI wall 34s (serial re-baseline 41s, committed phase-1 37s) poller peak 5,519,472kB — THE IDENTITY GATE PASSES BOTH: the receipts equal the committed phase-1 rebuilt receipts on every semantic field (0 diffs, only walls/rss_kb), all FOUR sidecars BYTE-IDENTICAL (exactness/ingredients/records/skeleton), binding counters identical (chrI 13,905 records / 1,415,203 occurrences / 14,629 candidates / 4,247,781 verify probes over 1,415,927 range fetches / 840 lane loads). THE PHASE PICTURE at chrI: binding 9.7s serial -> 6.8s at 2-wide (the 840 lane loads serialize behind their per-lane mutexes — the load phase is the floor); loci 13.1s serial -> 14.7s at 2-wide (a small LOSS — two live loci contend on the shared global pool and memory; measured, not assumed). chrMT serial re-baseline receipts also byte-identical (rung 0, committed ea64cca). # THE CLOSING SECTION — the whole arc's measured chain, from the windowed frame's broken domains to the final state

## The starting injury, measured (2026-09-29/30)
The windowed reference frame excluded the SK1 truth pair at **805 of 1,307 windows**; the product called ONE molecule everywhere (the haploid single-slot product failure, 0/3 and 0/10 two-slot calls at the smoke gates); only **4/502** expressible windows recovered the exact truth pair; the injective diploid genotype distance measured **0.5128** on the 6x/4x sample (v2 balanced 15x/15x: **0.3001**) - a sequence improvement, not correct diploid identities. The reference frame itself was the measured limitation (the dual-frame / proportional-coordinate problem, the partition-native spine named as the correction path).

## The realignment instrument (the per-locus marginal likelihood over the graph panel)
The per-locus realignment likelihood replaced the frame-dependent candidate domain: both homologs present and jointly spellable per window, the truth pair in the candidate universe. The committed default convention scored **549/1,133 expressible = 48.5%** truth rank-1 - the honest baseline the whole arc improved against.

## Fix 1 - the extent normalization (the territory-image rule, Stage 2)
The territory-image extent normalization (the over-long partition rows truncated to their real images) converted the extent class: **876/1,133 = 77.3%**, CONVERT 327 / REGRESS 0 (zero-regression guard holding fleet-wide), QV median 17.77 -> 60.00, perfect 874/1,133, QV>=40 77.41%. The wall-fix (the degenerate-locus tie certificate) and the checker-hygiene repair (the append-mode marker disease) landed inside this stage.

## Fix 2 - the alignment-induced locality domain (the owner's go: "try out the thing you think is gonna work")
The domain family that names its own universe from real alignment: the locality = the connected component of the axis row's PGBB graph; the fold = the path-interval hull of the maximal monotone axis-correspondence (pggb shared segments + interned syng nodes chained along the window spine, bounded to the component's own axis partitions); the over-join separation and the seam rejoins measured first (gate 1), the construction repaired on the gate's own evidence (the per-path fold merging broke the identical-copy coalescing - the chrMT L2/L7/L9/L10 regressions caught and repaired; the +K+W margin break), the no-op proof landed (the env-unset default path reproduces the committed receipts with 0 diffs). Gates 1-2 closed at chrMT/chrI: HOLD 9/9 + 14/14, ALL PHASES PASS 5,283,055/0 combined.

## Gate 3 - the fleet under the locality domains (17/17)
The substrate: 2,715 partition graphs built across two converging lanes (the full 1358-partition union todo, redundant-but-complete), **271,377/271,377 member rows spell-equal** to their export GFA P lines - the fleet's coordinates proven to be the syng coordinates. The chain per component: locality maps -> serial -> 4-wide -> the identity gate (0 semantic diffs, all four sidecars md5-identical, everywhere) -> the checker slices (--territory --locality, phase 8N's BEFORE pointed at the committed territory receipts). Six checker repair classes surfaced and were repaired live through the sweep, each unit-tested + mirror-gated byte-identical on the committed chrMT receipts (mirrors 1-6), the drivers marker-idempotent; the degenerate loci (chrVII L56, chrXII L86) passed live on the committed empty-product guards, and chrVII L83 (the one Poisson-expressible locus lost) honestly carried by the committed loss guard.

## THE FINAL STATE - the honest scoreboard, every number (17/17 components, 1,307 loci)
- **Truth rank-1: 880/1,132 expressible = 77.7%** (default convention 549/1,133 = 48.5% -> territory 876/1,133 = 77.3% -> locality 880/1,132 = 77.7%)
- **Expressibility: 1,133 -> 1,132** - gained 5 (chrX L50, chrXIV L9, chrXVI L8/L85/L93, the seam chain), lost 6 (chrV L59, chrVII L56+L83, chrXII L101, chrXV L49, chrXVI L7, the exact rule's honest cost), every move named
- **The conversion count vs the 193 addressable prediction: REFUTED - CONVERT 9 / REGRESS 5 / moved 350** (the 9 all unique wins by cause extent 4 / repeat-domain 4 / rival-dominant 1; the chrI-L13 interior-repeat mechanism measured genome-wide: the winners are connected in-component repeat-copy rows placing genuinely-better-matched high-multiplicity reads; rejoining severed ortholog material does not make the truth pair win - the advantage lives in the evidence model, not the geometry)
- **The 5 regressions** (the design's "any regression = design failure, named" contract, honored): the edge-pocket/hull-sensitivity class (chrIII L20 gap 0.27, chrXI L39 gap 0.23, chrXV L15 gap 0.21 - near-twin rival hulls at truncated truth folds; chrIII L35 gap 162.5 - the seam chain admitted BAQ_1a's 351bp-longer REAL ortholog) + the over-join separation class (chrVII L56, the degenerate 15bp contig-end window, the truth pair inexpressible)
- **QV re-run: n=1,132, PERFECT 880** (= the rank-1 count exactly - every rank-1 locus a zero-edit call), median 60.00, p10 14.42, p90 60.00, QV>=40 78.18% (was 77.41%), QV>=30 78.53%, QV>=20 79.42%; the non-rank-1 252 at median QV 14.67
- **Gate 4, the rival-dominant residue: 71 of 252** (interior-substitution 60 / twin-indistinguishable 7 / substitution-better-match 4 / zygosity-dosage 0 - the hypothesized dosage mechanism ABSENT; winner homozygous 0/71; 50 carry the pre-normalization signature); by census: in-axis 30+3 / neighbor 25+3 / foreign-repeat 3+1+1 of the interior-substitution class
- **The residue decomposition: 1,132 = 880 rank-1 + 71 rival-dominant + 181 seam/repeat-interior** (the 181 NOT addressable by geometry - the locality lever measured to convert only 9 of them; the 71 the irreducible copy-structure residue)
- **The sweep: 264,718,566 checks / 8 failure lines** (every failure the zero-regression guard's own naming of the 5 committed regression loci; four components closed gateregressed; the checker untouched, the goalposts unmoved)
- **Walls (arithmetic shown): the locality chain serial 3,086s + 4-wide 1,836s = 4,922s** (17/17, the .wall markers; the territory fleet's own chain: census 19,581s + anchor 7,268s + serial 2,504s + 4-wide 1,469s = 30,822s)

## The honest verdict for the whole arc
The measured chain: the windowed frame's broken domains (805/1,307 excluded, one molecule called, 4/502 recovered) were repaired by the realignment instrument (the truth pair in the universe at 1,133 expressible loci), the extent normalization (+327, the geometry that WAS real), and the alignment-induced locality domain (+4 net: 9 conversions against 5 named regressions - the strongest geometry candidate, built on real alignment, honestly measured small and two-sided). **The geometry-lever program is measured to exhaustion**: what remains (252 loci) is not addressable by geometry - 71 rival-dominant by the receipts' own both-placed evidence and 181 seam/repeat-interior where the winners place genuinely-better-matched repeat-family reads on real ortholog material. The next lever, if any, lives in the evidence model - a decision for the owner, with the honest scoreboard now standing at 880/1,132 = 77.7%, perfect calls 880, and every number above carried by committed receipts, identity gates, and a 264,718,566-check sweep whose only failures are the design's own loudly-named costs. Standing rules held to the last commit: truth assessment-side only; no thresholds; the scoreboard machinery unmodified; no product selection swap; no 502; stdbuf; the 64GiB guard clean everywhere; never from the repo root; never the pilot receipt commits. Final commit: 8e22841. Tree clean of tracked changes. THE ARC IS CLOSED.

## 2026-11-XX SESSION OPEN — THE FLANK-OVERLAP CANDIDATE FILTER (the owner's design, stated verbatim, then measured)

**THE OWNER'S RULING, VERBATIM:** "THE PROBLEM (the owner's observation from likegt results): haplotypes that do not fully overlap the genotyped locus - assembly breaks, fragmentary panel entries - enter the candidate universe and get mixed into calls inappropriately; the called pairs built from fragmentary members are themselves fragmentary, driving accuracy losses and super-low QV. THE OWNER'S BET (state it, then measure): many of the error/low-QV windows are fragmentary-member windows. THE RULE, IMPLEMENTED IN THE QUERY/PARTITION MACHINERY (the member-row/candidate-universe construction, per partition, driven by the BED): a panel member is KEPT in a partition's candidate universe only if it covers BOTH FLANKS - the first N bp and the last N bp of the region, in the FOCAL REFERENCE's coordinates (the reference doing the query). Members missing either flank are removed. THE PARAMETER FORMS: N in bp (e.g. --flank-overlap 10000 for 10kb flanks); a PERCENT form (--flank-overlap 10% -> ceil(pct x region length) - the owner suspects percent is the safest general form); THE DEGENERATE CASE: if the region is shorter than N, the rule reduces to simple presence in the region; OFF BY DEFAULT - the committed candidate universe is byte-identical without the flag; the flag applies uniformly to every partition from the BED; the excluded rows are loudly counted and named per partition (the --exclude-paths precedent is the pattern)."

**THE WORK, AS RULED:** (1) this session-open increment; (2) survey the member spans (the catalog/member rows, locus.members.bed, the coverage columns - the exact source of truth for each member's span over the partition, in the focal reference's coordinate frame); (3) implement the filter (the flag on the partition/call path, both parameter forms, the degenerate rule, default-off proven: the committed chain-L1 invocation with the flag unset -> calls.jsonl BYTE-IDENTICAL); (4) THE CENSUS FIRST (measure the object before designing the lever): every window of the committed five-locality receipts (pilot + L1-L4, both depths) classified full-overlap vs fragmentary at the 10kb and 10% settings, correlated with the error/QV classes (the low-QV windows, the rank-2 misses, the inexpressible loci) - the falsifiable prediction tested; (5) THE MEASUREMENT: re-run the five localities with the filter at the measured settings, --truth-qv, scored vs the committed baselines (rank-1, PERFECT, the QV distributions, the low-QV tail's fate - the owner's bet: the fragmentary-call class improves; if REFUTED, state it plainly); the masked/stranger leg too; (6) THE VERDICT: the census table, the delta tables, whether the filter belongs in the default product (the owner said off-by-default - the receipt informs the decision), the datasheet + record increments; commit per gate. STANDING: truth assessment-side only; the committed receipts immutable baselines; no thresholds/tuning constants (the flank settings are the owner's example points + the percent form; the default is OFF); NO PR PUSH (the owner pushes).

**THE SOURCE OF TRUTH, SURVEYED (before any code):** the candidate universe per window is the partition map's member rows (`window<N>.gfa.map.json` under the locality-graphs; `MemberRow {path_name, start, end}` in `src/genome_inference/realign_score.rs`), and their `start`/`end` ARE the focal reference's own coordinate frame - the axis row of each window (the component's own row) spans exactly the window's extent in that frame (L1 window0: axis [0,10036), window12: [120058,130037), window24: [240050,251156) over the 251,156bp territory), and every member row's [start,end) is its aligned extent in the SAME frame. The fragmentary members are directly visible in the maps: rows that start late (120362 > the window's 120058) or end early (128917 < 130037). `locus.members.bed` is the panel-fetch side (each member's own-path slice interval); the partition maps are the call-side spans. Implementation begins; increments follow.

**Increment 1 — THE FILTER IMPLEMENTED (both forms, the degenerate rule, default-off proven) + THE SEMANTIC FORK MEASURED AND RULED (the receipt that protects the semantics decision).** (1) THE IMPLEMENTATION: `--flank-overlap` on `call-diplotypes` AND `call-region` (the partition/call path; call-region delegates), both parameter forms (`10000` bp; `10%` -> ceil(pct x window length)), THE DEGENERATE CASE (a window shorter than N reduces to simple presence), THE AXIS ROW NEVER EXCLUDED (the --exclude-paths precedent - it is the coordinate frame), the excluded rows loudly counted and named per locus (the product record gains `flank_excluded_rows` + `flank_overlap` beside the unchanged `excluded_rows` pattern; the stderr names the partition and the window extent), and OFF BY DEFAULT. `FlankOverlap` + `row_covers_flanks` in realign_score (pure predicates, the fold-construction site is the member-row/candidate-universe construction per partition, driven by the maps' own axis rows - the BED's regions). GATES: cargo build clean; cargo test --release --lib 551/551 (4 new: the both-forms parsing, the flank-presence rule, the percent ceil, the degenerate case); THE DEFAULT-OFF PROOF: the committed chain-L1 invocation VERBATIM with the new binary, flag unset -> calls.jsonl BYTE-IDENTICAL to the committed cut-L1-cli receipt, the biWFA fields 25/25 identical, THE EMISSION GATE ALL CHECKS PASS (reproduced twice - once per semantics revision; receipts: writeup-codification/chain-L1*).
